decisions.reason: As a burner component within the established radiant-heating platform, it is likely to stay as a supporting portfolio item, though it is somewhat more exposed than full system lines to later portfolio simplification.
The electric infrared panel heater line is a strategic flagship with several models and fits the firm’s push toward broader, lower-carbon building-climate solutions.
The electric halogen infrared heater still broadens the offer, but it is less central than the flagship lines and faces the highest overlap and niche-risk within the portfolio.
The industrial electric infrared hall heater line serves the firm’s core large-space customer base and matches demand for efficient electrified hall heating in non-residential buildings.
The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater is closely aligned with the firm’s low-carbon roadmap and has an early real-world reference, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
